ExhaustionDef.description:
How a stat lowers the food exhaustion its player gains (architecture 8.1, RLM-171): from sprinting, jumping,
swimming, attacking, taking damage, mining and the Hunger effect, everything vanilla adds through
``Player#causeFoodExhaustion``. Natural regeneration's food cost stays vanilla's. The shares of several stats add
up, at most 100 %.

max_percent.description: The most it lowers exhaustion, in percent (at most 100).
max_percent.title: Max Percent

per_point_percent.description: How much each point lowers exhaustion, in percent.
per_point_percent.title: Per Point Percent

ExhaustionDef.title: ExhaustionDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description:
One of our attributes: a primary stat (strength, dexterity, vitality, intellect) that stat rules read, or a
secondary stat that stat rules and other sources write (crit chance, spell power, ...). Generates its
registration, added to every player. Its minimum is 0.

A stat counts either points (``default``, ``max``) or a share (``default_percent``, ``max_percent``, written
in percent and shown as a percentage in the game). Primary stats count points. Its name is the attribute's
translation, ``attribute.realmforge.<id>``: the character sheet and item tooltips show it.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

kind.description: primary: read by stat rules (content/stat_rules/); secondary: written by them and other sources.
kind.title: Kind

lowers_exhaustion.description: Each point lowers the food exhaustion the player gains (Stamina); a stat in points only.

name.description: The stat's name, shown on the character sheet and in tooltips.

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

resists.description: A damage type tag whose hits this stat lowers by its share, e.g. minecraft:is_projectile or realmforge:is_physical (architecture 9.1, RLM-233); a share only. Several such stats on one hit multiply.
resists.title: Resists
